name: skribbl-clone
description: A real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game built with React, Socket.IO, and MongoDB.

scripts.dev: npm run check:env && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "node --check server/src/index.js" "npm --prefix client run build"
scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server test" "npm --prefix client test"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
